hollis.note: In s2-06 you ended with two tea and two saffron while Tamsin kept all three silk, worth 6 to you. Tamsin's own offer o3 had given you all the silk, a sign it mattered little to them: ask for the goods they give away easily.

marlow.note: In s2-09 you accepted at action 3 and gave up the saffron you had asked for: 0.80 instead of 0.90. Restating your offer would have replaced theirs, a real risk, but with five actions left there was time to come back to it.
